Record Class ChatDbKey

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.meshtastic.client.components.chat.ChatDbKey
public record ChatDbKey(String dbType, String dbKey, String readKey, String preferenceId, String scrollStateKey) extends Record
Stable database and preference keys for a chat.

The UI works with ChatItem, while persistence uses string pairs such as channel/0 and dm/!abcd1234. This record keeps those conversions in one place so form code does not repeat channel/direct branches.
